Esta traducción intenta utilizar un Español "Neutral" para que pueda ser utilizada tanto por Latinoamericanos como por Europeos Hispanohablantes y siempre evitando perder el gran sentido del humor de este Juego. (Sin embargo, puede ser considerada como una traducción en Español predominantemente Latinoamericano)

1. Da clic en el botón "Suscribirse".

4. En la lista de mods busca la traducción llamada "Traducción al Español".
5. Dale un clic para activarla.

publishedfiledetails.title: Beefalo Status Bar
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1]Beefalo Status Bar[/h1]
It shows up when you mount a beefalo, goes away when you dismount. You can also toggle it on or off (when mounted) if you feel like it's getting in your way.
Note that toggling will override the "Show Automatically" setting for the current shard session (going in and out of the caves or reloading will reset it to whatever it was originally set to).


[h1]Information[/h1]
Most everything should be pretty straight forward, except maybe the tendency and the hunger badge, so let me explain.

[h1]Domestication and Tendency:[/h1]
The color of the domestication badge will reflect the current tendency of your beefalo. This is configurable, but by default it goes like this:
[img=https://i.imgur.com/bHMl3Sb.png ] [img=https://i.imgur.com/877HBr0.png ] [img=https://i.imgur.com/Mk7X39h.png ] [img=https://i.imgur.com/LtxSAfE.png ]

There are 13 colors (8 unique and 5 variations) to choose from.

Note: Last I checked, the only time the game tries to make your beefalo domesticated is when you feed it. This means that when you reach 100% domestication your beefalo won't become domesticated until you feed it something.

[h1]Ride Timer:[/h1]
This badge shows how much time you have left riding your beefalo before it bucks you off. Hovering over it will show you how many uses your saddle has left.
[b]Note[/b]: Your saddle will [b]NOT[/b] lose durability when the timer runs out. The only time this happens is when the beefalo shakes it off it's back.

[h1]Hunger Badge:[/h1]
Your beefalo needs to have at least 15 hunger (configurable) at mount time to activate the hunger badge. Once activated, when the beefalo's hunger reaches 0 it will deactivate itself again.
This should be low enough to easily trigger it while still in the process of domestication, but high enough to almost never see it once your beefalo is fully domesticated.


[h1]F.A.Q.[/h1]
[b]I don't see the numbers below the badges, why?[/b]
- They are a feature of another mod called [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=376333686]Combined Status[/url][/b]. In order to see them you will need to download/subscribe to it (and enable it). [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=376333686]Click here[/url] to do just that.

[b]Can you make this a client only mod?[/b]
- No. Unfortunately, the beefalo information is not available on the client, so a client only version is not possible.

[b]I'm using a HUD reskin mod, how do I make this mod use the reskinned badges?[/b]
- Set the "Theme" option to "Default Theme".


[h1]Latest Changelog:[/h1]
[h1]v1.4.0[/h1]
[h1]General[/h1]
- Added support for resetting the ride timer by raising obedience when mounted.
- Added Beige color (or close to it) as a color choice for all badges.
- Changed the default domestication badge color for "Default" beefalo from White to Beige.
- Increased the default hunger badge threshold from 10 to 15.

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
- Fixed an issue causing the Status Bar to move up a little bit each time the player changes characters when using The Forge theme without Combined Status.

[h3]Other:[/h3]
- A small backend change for future-proofing that will hopefully not cause any trouble.

[h3]Notes:[/h3]
- In the upcoming game update, beefalo can be fed while mounted. This will increase their obedience (unless already maxed out), which will reset the ride timer. In case other scenarios where obedience is raised while riding are to be added in the future (like brushing for example), they should be properly accounted for as well.
- Due to how mod configurations work in the game, if you already have a saved configuration the new defaults may not be properly reflected until you reset or change them manually.

publishedfiledetails.title: Auto Stack and Pick Up
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
This mod gives you MANY settings for automatically stacking or picking up newly spawned and manually dropped stackable items. By 'automatically stacking' I mean that if an item is spawned (e.g., loot from monsters or workables, like trees) or it is manually dropped on the ground by the player, it looks for other stacks on the ground to merge with. All features can be enabled individually.

You can also individually enable that if the player is within range, they will automatically pick up ANY stackable item spawned near them. You can also set whether the player MUST have one of the item in their inventory already for the auto pickup to happen. Useful in order to avoid cluttering your inventory with useless things!

The mod can coincidentally [b]improve FPS[/b] (or rather, performance) because it reduces the amount of separate items on the map. You can toggle whether everything spawned on the ground during world generation / load should be auto stacked with similar things close by, which should improve FPS for everyone on your server.

[b]Credit:[/b] This mod was inspired by the mod [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1216718131]AntiStun[/url] for DST, but was rewritten to add more features and options.

[h1][b]Settings Information[/b][/h1]
[i][u]PLEASE NOTE: Many settings are TURNED OFF BY DEFAULT.[/u][/i]
---== [b]General Settings[/b] ==---
[b]Puff On Stack[/b]: Toggle whether auto stacking is visualized by playing a smoke puff effect.

---== [b]World Spawn Settings[/b] ==---
[b]World Drop Auto Stack[/b]: Enable/disable automatically stacking items dropped by the world.
[b]World Gen Auto Stack[/b]: Controls whether items being spawned / placed while generating or loading a world should auto stack. Turn this off to keep the aesthetics generated by the world generation algorithm, e.g., a random skeleton might have more than one stack of the same item among the items spread out around it.
[b]World Auto Stack Range[/b]: The radius within which a newly spawned item will look for stacks to add itself to.
[b]World Auto Stack In[/b]: Setting this to 'Existing' means that new drops are added to surrounding stacks. 'Newest' means surrounding stacks are added to the newest stack.
[b]World Auto Stack Ash[/b]: Also auto stack newly spawned ash?
[b]World Auto Stack Poop[/b]: Also auto stack newly spawned poop?
[b]World Auto Stack Seeds[/b]: Also auto stack newly spawned seeds?

A：猪人房一定不会清理，猪人房不见了是不是被人砸了。。猪人、猪人房都不会被清理，如果被清理是直接从这个世界删除，不会留下任何东西，去猪村捡到猪皮这个应该是其他怪物把猪杀了。蜘蛛巢会清理，整个世界蜘蛛巢最大数量可以自定义设置。

Q4：洞穴也在清理范围吗？
A：一般情况下，每个世界都有一个单独的mod控制文件（modoverrides.lua）对这个世界进行设置，如果你那个独立服务器的mod控制文件里面有这个mod，那就会清理。你可以做个测试，比如说放10把斧头放在你有疑惑的洞穴里面，同时把这个mod的清理天数设置为1天，看看斧头会不会被清理掉。

Q5：这个mod巨大作物他会堆叠 但是敲出来是小作物？
A：图8~12亲测砸掉巨大作物种子和果实会堆叠，数量和不堆叠几乎一样。巨大作物本身不会堆叠，用锤子砸了之后会堆叠，其本质是：巨大作物打碎（假设是巨大火龙果，打碎后获得3个火龙果2个火龙果种子 ），5个物品掉在地上，地上因为物品变化开始调用堆叠程序 ，堆叠之后，地上残留1组火龙果（3个）+1组火龙果种子 （2个）。如果有2个巨型火龙果一起打碎，那么打碎之后地上残留1组火龙果（6个）+1组火龙果种子 （4个）。图8~图12的测试图，第一张是不开我这个mod的时候砸碎6个巨大火龙果，火龙果果实和种子散落一地（捡起来后就是图二背包里面的17个火龙果和13个种子），第二张是我开着这个mod之后砸碎6个巨大火龙果，火龙果果实和种子各自成一组（也就是你说的“一个巨大植物的种子和果实”），具体统计数据是（15个果实14个种子）。
所以最后的结论是，单独测试我这个mod，砸碎巨型果实掉落的果实数量和种子数量应该是和不开这个mod一样的。你的档里出现了只掉落一个种子和果实的情况我不知道你是不是因为他们堆叠了导致只看到了一个种子和果实还是真的只有一个种子和果实（比如说砸碎6个火龙果，最后得到6个果实+6个种子），如果是后面的情况，可能是什么mod和这个mod发生了冲突，你可以尝试挨个排查一下 。

Q6：能不能清理树桩和树种？
A：用控制台生成一个树桩用的是树桩 的代码，但是用控制台删除一个树桩却用的是常青树的代码，我尝试过在清理内容里面添加“常青树桩、桦树树桩”代码，清理的时候没用，却能通过清理常青树代码清理掉树桩，我自己也是郁闷的。因此结论是暂时没法用专门的代码清理掉树桩。

Q7：这个怎么修改清理的时间呢？
A：清理时间的修改在mod修改页修改，具体图片可以在上面第二张图里面“清理周期”作为参考。

Q8：我的狗牙都几十组了为啥不会自动清啊？狗牙陷阱是不是会清理啊？
A：狗牙几十组你放在哪里？放箱子里、背包里的都不会清理，放地上才会。狗牙陷阱不会被清理，你的狗牙陷阱少了说不定是耐久用完了……

Q9: 

Q10：可不可以清mod人物的专属武器呀？
A：暂时不可以清理mod人物的专属武器，因为mod人物众多，添加起来很费劲，同时不同的人玩不同的mod人物导致受众面太小。

Q11：想问一下常青树这种东西是怎么个清理法？
A：常青树清理包括：小常青树、中常青树、大常青树、枯萎常青树、常青树桩。清理是清理这些常青树类型所有之和相加≤你设定的树值。

2023-09-09
- Fixed nil ground name error causing crash

2022-08-13
- Fixed issue with waypoints shared on online servers due to DST update (Thank you Dragon O' Chaos for pointing at the core issue in bug report)
- You can choose 'None' as a keybind option
- Keybind for toggle indicators and markers set to None, you can rebind it in config or otherwise you can now use [b]Shift[/b] + [b]X[/b] (keybind for toggle GUI) instead
- Additional config to disable auto travel
- Additional config to show player and waypoint coordinate information (by default set to false)
- Thanks to all who are still using the mod when I'm not active anymore :X

The ability to add a waypoint at your position and bring up a list of waypoints to travel towards.
- Can toggle GUI that displays a list of waypoints (default key is [b]X[/b])
- Can toggle waypoint indicators and markers (default key is [b]Shift[/b] + [b]X[/b])
- Waypoints are persistent and also separate for each world and caves

Partially supports controllers.

- Scoreboard screen & [b]Right Trigger[/b]: Add waypoint

[h1]FAQ[/h1]
Q: Why does my character not travel to the waypoint correctly?
A: Waypoint mod uses the in-game's [i]move to[/i] function to travel to a destination. If the route is too complex, it will make your character travel simply move straight towards destination ignoring any obstacles.

Q: Can other players see my waypoints/markers?
A: No, this is a client-only mod which means only you will be able to see your waypoints and markers (therefore it is not shared in any way).

Q: How can I add a waypoint?
A: This mod is an interface and does not require you to craft anything to use it. The default key is [b]X[/b] to bring up the waypoint manager. To add a waypoint, click the flag on the upper right corner of the interface.

Q: How can I delete a waypoint?
A: To delete a waypoint you need to directly modify the waypoint by bringing up the dialog and you should see the trash icon at the top right corner. To be able to modify any waypoint, you need to toggle edit mode by clicking on the wrench icon on the interface.

publishedfiledetails.title: Global Positions (CompleteSync)
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h2] Main feature [/h2]
Just like the original [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=378160973]Global Positioning[/url], it allows players to share exploration maps and mark signals on the map. However when using original mod, the maps between players are not completely synchronized, for example:
1. The player just joined the game, and the other players on the map have explored many places, but the newly added player cannot see the places explored by other players before he joined.
2. Player A is on the ground, and player B goes to the cave to explore. When player A enters the cave, he cannot see the place explored by player B before he enters the cave.
3. The player read the message in the bottle of the Crabby Hermit, and other players will not update the map like player A.
This mod solves these problems and can achieve complete synchronization. See the videos for a demonstration.

[h2]Bugs fixed：[/h2]
1. Fix the far away point of interest bug in the original mod.
[img=https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2425844467144089786/684C53427208270FBCB431A1E0ED9042045348A4/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false][/img]
2. The bug in the original mod that caused the signal marker to possibly deviate from the mouse position has been fixed. (In the original mod, if you dragged the map to its extreme position and continued dragging, the map would no longer move with the mouse. After that, the signal marker would deviate from the mouse position.)
3. Fixed the longstanding issue of icon misalignment in modules related to global positioning. Sometimes, the icons on the map would misalign, resulting in "mirages" on the map. For example, users might find that the building icons of their base are copied to another location on the map, or they may encounter strange icons outside the map boundaries. In fact, I believe this is a bug within the game itself, and the Global Position-type mods simply make it more likely to trigger ([url=https://forums.kleientertainment.com/klei-bug-tracker/dont-starve-together/a-long-standing-bug-in-the-maprevealer-which-causes-map-icons-to-be-misaligned-r46911/]Bug report[/url]).
(Update: Klei has claimed to have fixed the bug I reported. It's very likely that this issue has also been resolved in other global positioning mods.)
[img=https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2425844467144080073/2844A976983D26F443E1087CF68152156035589F/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false][/img]
[img=https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/43440899924063808/7F394F1C087EB999B30E6A27C28C488B30DFB27F/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false][/img]
4. Fixed the issue where the Beefalo icons would leave ghosting effects when their owner moving too quickly. In fact, this is a bug in the game itself, which I reported on the forum ([url=https://forums.kleientertainment.com/klei-bug-tracker/dont-starve-together/domesticated-beefalo-still-produce-map-icon-trails-r46296/?tab=comments#comment-66665]link[/url]). This mod will display the beefalo_bell icon instead of the beefalo. You can disable this option in the settings under "Remove Ghost Icons".

[h2]Other functions:[/h2]
1. Now Walter can deliver items to teammates without using a compass. This feature can also be disabled in the options. Thanks to @Kerr for providing the coding idea.
2. Map areas revealed by the Zaptrocuter are now visible to all players, alongside a new option that allows the flying Portable Storage Unit's icon to be seen by everyone.
3. Added acceleration options to help reduce server CPU usage. All of these options are disabled by default. Among them, “Quick Map share” is expected to be quite effective and can be enabled if needed. Many thanks to @暮色黯然 and hisfriends for their enthusiastic testing.
There are also options for “Disable fogrevealer” and “Remove maprevealer tag,” which might help reduce CPU consumption, though I’m not certain. These two options can cause other side effects, so it is recommended to leave them disabled. Enabling “Disable fogrevealer” will remove the circular bright area around teammates' icons, and will also prevent Wortox from jumping directly onto a teammate’s boat. Enabling “Remove maprevealer tag” will cause map icon updates around players to no longer synchronize. For example, if Player A digs up a tuft of grass, this option may cause Player B’s map to still show the grass icon. If you're interested, feel free to help test whether these two options provide a significant performance improvement—your feedback would be greatly appreciated.


======================

Note:
1. The mod is implemented based on the mod [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=378160973]Global Positions[/url]. In the previous version, I also used the codes from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2902364746]Global Positions -Remapped[/url] to sync the map. Please subscribe to them as a gesture of support (of course, the normal functioning of my mod doesn't rely on other mods).
2. If there are bugs or other modification suggestions, please give feedback. I sincerely apologize for the recent bugs that have caused map loss. If you still lost the explored map in the newest version, please leave a comment.
3. Known issue: If you switch from the original global positioning to this mod in an old save file, and immediately change characters or save the game, it can cause the loss of map exploration progress in caves. A temporary workaround is to visit the caves once before switching characters or save the game for the first time. I'm still trying to fix this problem. For now, it's best to use this mod in a new save file. Additionally, disabling this mod mid-game may also lead to map loss. If you need to disable this mod for some purposes like resolving mod conflicts, please make sure to back up your save file or record the maps of the cave and the forest into a map scroll. Thank @󰀐超级麦旋风 and @Halo Lemon for testing.
4. You may check the codes in [url=https://github.com/hellohawaii2/Global-Position-CompleteSync]Github[/url]

[h1]Uncompromising Mode increases the risk and reward for Don't Starve Together.[/h1]
[b]Uncompromising Mode (often shortened to "Uncomp" or "UM") was created with the goal of revitalizing the difficulty of DST. The mod adds randomness, variety, and challenge to the game's core mechanics, without making the experience annoying and tedious. However, it isn't simply just "a harder experience". Uncompromising Mode houses a lot of new content such as new mechanics, items, mobs, biomes, and bosses.[/b]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/g02TMF9Q/charlineup.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KLOQxQi.png[/img]
* Three new characters, and a total mechanical rework of Walter!
* Rebalances and tweaks to nearly everything in the game!
* Night Terrors! Something may be lurking in the dark.
* New Weather Events, such as Snow Storms.
* More Nightmare Creatures. Insanity is an actual threat now; Stay past the brink and you may never return.
* A new overworld biome called the Hooded Forest, which houses a lot of new content including a new boss.
* A bunch of new items and mobs, ranging from dangerous to helpful.
* Some mobs have new attacks, ranging from spiders to bosses.
* The Veteran's Curse, a special Difficulty mode that grants access to powerful items at the cost of your wellbeing.
* Character tweaks and reworks. The Big 3 have had their downsides more pronounced, Willow has more fire-related perks, Maxwell has access to his singleplayer shadow puppets, small animals don't drop souls for Wortox, etc.
* A custom OST, containing music composed by Adam Ogrodnik.

publishedfiledetails.file_description:
With this mod you can repair your equipment with the same equipment.

So you can combine a logsuit with 10% and a logsuit with 30% to a logsuit with 40%!

[u]This mod works for things with:[/u]
[b]finiteuses (like weapons), armor, fueled and perishable+equipable[/b].

Added in modsettings "bonus durability". By default it is off.
You can choose from +1% to +10% or even randomly. Also negative bonus is possible, if you prefer.
So when combining a 30% item and a 40% item, you may get an item with up to 80% if you wish so.

Also works correctly for stackables like Bull Kelp Stalk and mod items.


[url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198102311542/myworkshopfiles/?appid=322330] [h1][u]Also take a look at other mods I made, see my workshop ;)[/u][/h1] [/url]

DS version from another author:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1532277729


[u]Update 12.12.2019:[/u]
- Added option to disable/enable repair-combine for specific components. (all enabled by default)
So if you want to be able to repair-combine weapons/tools (finiteuses) but not anything fuelable or perishable, you can change the settings accordingly.

- Added option to also increase the max values! (disabled by default)
A spear usually has a max usage of 150. 
If this setting is enabled, and you combine 2 full spears, you will get one spear with 300 of 300 uses (will still show 100%). 
If you combine instead a spear with 100 uses left (66.6%) and a spear with 60 uses left (33.3%), you will get a spear with 160 of 160 uses left (100%).
For fueled items, like a lantern, this means after combinging eg. 10 full lanters, the new lantern can hold 10 times more fuel.
I highly recommend a mod like "Insight" to show you the current/max uses of an item, since the percentages will be confusing with these "overmax" settings enabled.


In case I get inactive and do not respond to bugfixes/feature requests, everyone is free to fork this or other of my mods to fix/expand them, but please link to the original. As long as I'm responding also feel free to write new/better code for it and I may upload it and add you as author if you want.
